run_query_text_classification: run the query function to classify text sentiment using the distilbert SST-2 model
test_query_function: test the query function with a sample input string for text classification
build_api_request: build an API request to send text input to the Hugging Face inference endpoint
create_query_with_headers: create a query call with Bearer token authorization headers for the HF inference API
review_query_response: review the query function that posts JSON payload and returns response JSON from the model endpoint
